scope: Phase 2 of the shared-core plan: the Unity host over libweva. This receipt grows with the phase; each step records its gate as it lands.

step_1_plugin_build.target: godot-port/hosts/unity (weva_core shared library; static CRT and ICU; only weva_* exported from weva_c.h and weva_unity.h)

windows.load_test: weva_core_load_test: abi 0.25, button at 10.0,10.0 size 29.3x22.0, 4 draws, layout probe sizes match, ok
windows.build_json: weva_core.dll.build.json stamped (library and source digests, git state, compiler, ABI 0.25)

linux.exports: 113 dynamic symbols, all weva_* (version script, local: *); a first build exported none because hidden visibility was applied to the core objects before the version script could pick them, fixed by scoping the preset to the plugin sources
linux.load_test: weva_core_load_test: abi 0.25, button at 10.0,10.0 size 29.3x22.0, 4 draws, ok (identical geometry to Windows)

step_1_plugin_build.ci: godot-ci.yml job unity-plugin (ubuntu-24.04, windows-2022): build, load test, gen_bindings --check; check.sh gate "unity plugin"
step_1_plugin_build.gate: met: the DLL loads in Unity 6000.4.1f1 EditMode and weva_abi_version() reports 0.25 (Plugin_ReportsHeaderAbiVersion)

step_2_bindings.shape: blittable: unsafe pointers, nuint for size_t, fixed buffers for arrays, delegate* unmanaged[Cdecl] callback fields, Cdecl DllImport externs; nothing marshalled, so Mono and IL2CPP share the file

cases: GeneratedStruct_MatchesNativeSize x12 (weva_config, weva_vertex, weva_rounded_rect, weva_backdrop_effect, weva_draw, weva_texture, weva_render_backend, weva_glyph_bitmap, weva_font_backend, weva_shaped_glyph, weva_event, weva_binding_source)
Document_RoundTrips (create, HTML, CSS, update, focus_next, tag name, bounds 10,10, draws with triangles, destroy)

step_2_bindings.gate: met: the document round trip passes from C# in EditMode and agrees with the C++ load test

steps_open: 3 font adapter over TextCore/TMP (weva_font_backend + positioned shaper; port font_backend_tests.cpp checks to NUnit)
4 render adapter (weva_document_draws into the URP path; compare_render.py against the Godot render)
6 bindings and controllers (Frontier Camp logic in a Unity script)
7 layout-dump from Unity for the three-way oracle
limitations: The Unity editor is not on the CI runners; the EditMode run is recorded here and must be rerun by hand after header or generator changes.
Windows x64 only in the package (Plugins/x86_64); the Linux .so builds and passes the load test but is not installed in the package.
The plugin binary is gitignored; build it with hosts/unity (README) before the Native EditMode tests can run.
No font or render backend is wired yet, so the round trip's text metrics come from the core's built-in fallback face.
